output.reason: On its own, the cited bullet [ev-d62d2a7618cb] is only a metric name, but its section header [ev-1f419676f177] says what happens to it. In 3.0.0, metrics in this list that started with `cortex_` change to start with `loki_`, because `metrics_namespace` now defaults to `loki`. Operators can keep the `cortex_` prefix by setting `metrics_namespace` to `cortex`, but that setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. That gives the subject (the metric `cortex_prometheus_notifications_errors_total`), the change (renamed to the `loki_` prefix), who is exposed (anyone left on the default `metrics_namespace`) and what happens (the metric is no longer emitted under its old `cortex_` name).
